```{r}
# ============================================================
# Item-level high-score rates among clinically depressed youths
# Purpose:
#   1. Use pure depression participants with both scale data and medical profiles
#   2. Score DSRSC, CDI, PHQ-9, and DASS depression items at item level
#   3. Calculate high-score rate for each item
#   4. Export item-level summary and mapping template
# ============================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

# ============================================================
# 0. Read data
# ============================================================

raw_dep <- read_excel(
  here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_Depression_Pure.xlsx")
) %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID))

cmp_dep <- read_excel(
  here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_depression_pure.xlsx")
) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(门诊ID),
    history_text = as.character(现病史)
  ) %>%
  select(ID, history_text)

# Keep participants who have both scale data and medical profiles
dat <- raw_dep %>%
  inner_join(cmp_dep, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(history_text),
    str_squish(history_text) != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Clinically depressed participants with both scale data and medical profiles:", nrow(dat), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 1. Define item lists and reverse-scored items
# ============================================================

DSRSC_items <- paste0("DSRSC", 1:18)
PHQ_items   <- paste0("PHQ", 1:9)
CDI_items   <- paste0("CDI", c(1:25, 27))  # CDI26 is not scored

DASS_dep_items <- c(
  "DASS3", "DASS5", "DASS10",
  "DASS13", "DASS16", "DASS17", "DASS21"
)

CDI_reverse_items <- c(
  "CDI2", "CDI5", "CDI7", "CDI8", "CDI10", "CDI11", "CDI13",
  "CDI15", "CDI16", "CDI18", "CDI21", "CDI24", "CDI25"
)

DSRSC_reverse_items <- c(
  "DSRSC3", "DSRSC5", "DSRSC6", "DSRSC10",
  "DSRSC14", "DSRSC15", "DSRSC17", "DSRSC18"
)

# Keep only existing columns, in case some item names differ
DSRSC_items <- intersect(DSRSC_items, names(dat))
PHQ_items <- intersect(PHQ_items, names(dat))
CDI_items <- intersect(CDI_items, names(dat))
DASS_dep_items <- intersect(DASS_dep_items, names(dat))

all_item_cols <- c(DSRSC_items, PHQ_items, CDI_items, DASS_dep_items)

cat("DSRSC items:", length(DSRSC_items), "\n")
cat("PHQ items:", length(PHQ_items), "\n")
cat("CDI scored items:", length(CDI_items), "\n")
cat("DASS depression items:", length(DASS_dep_items), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 2. Score items
#    Assumption follows previous preprocessing:
#    - DSRSC, PHQ, CDI raw responses are converted to 0-based scores by subtracting 1
#    - DASS raw responses are converted to 0-based scores by subtracting 1
#    - DSRSC and CDI reverse items are reversed after 0-based conversion
# ============================================================

dat_scored <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(all_item_cols), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(DSRSC_items, PHQ_items, CDI_items)), ~ .x - 1)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(DASS_dep_items), ~ .x - 1)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(DSRSC_reverse_items, names(.))), ~ 2 - .x)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(CDI_reverse_items, names(.))), ~ 2 - .x))

# ============================================================
# 3. Convert to long format and define high item score
# ============================================================

item_long <- dat_scored %>%
  select(ID, history_text, all_of(all_item_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_item_cols),
    names_to = "item_id",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    scale = case_when(
      str_detect(item_id, "^DSRSC") ~ "DSRSC",
      str_detect(item_id, "^PHQ")   ~ "PHQ-9",
      str_detect(item_id, "^CDI")   ~ "CDI",
      str_detect(item_id, "^DASS")  ~ "DASS-Depression",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    high_score = case_when(
      scale %in% c("DSRSC", "CDI") ~ score == 2,
      scale %in% c("PHQ-9", "DASS-Depression") ~ score >= 2,
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. Calculate item-level high-score rates
# ============================================================

item_high_summary <- item_long %>%
  group_by(scale, item_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_depression = sum(!is.na(score)),
    n_high = sum(high_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_score_rate = n_high / n_depression,
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_score = min(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_score = max(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(scale, desc(high_score_rate), item_id)

# ============================================================
# 5. Create mapping template
#    Fill item_text, fine_symptom, and coarser_symptom manually later.
# ============================================================

mapping_template <- item_high_summary %>%
  mutate(
    item_text = "",
    fine_symptom = "",
    coarser_symptom = "",
    notes = ""
  ) %>%
  select(
    scale,
    item_id,
    item_text,
    fine_symptom,
    coarser_symptom,
    n_depression,
    n_high,
    high_score_rate,
    mean_score,
    sd_score,
    min_score,
    max_score,
    notes
  )

# ============================================================
# 6. Export
# ============================================================

write.xlsx(
  list(
    Item_high_score_rates = item_high_summary,
    Mapping_template = mapping_template,
    Participant_item_scores_long = item_long
  ),
  here("OUTPUT", "Scale_item_high_score_rates_depression.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  dat_scored %>%
    select(ID, history_text, all_of(all_item_cols)),
  here("OUTPUT", "Depression_item_level_scored_with_text.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("Done.\n")
cat("Exported:\n")
cat("  OUTPUT/Scale_item_high_score_rates_depression.xlsx\n")
cat("  OUTPUT/Depression_item_level_scored_with_text.xlsx\n")
```



```{r}
# ============================================================
# Calculate medical-profile mention rates by coarser symptom
# Input:
#   data/symptom_to_expression.xlsx
#     columns: coarser_symptom, expression
#
#   OUTPUT/Depression_item_level_scored_with_text.xlsx
#     columns: ID, history_text, item scores...
#
# Output:
#   OUTPUT/Medical_profile_symptom_mention_rates.xlsx
# ============================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

# ============================================================
# 0. Paths
# ============================================================

profile_file <- here("OUTPUT", "Depression_item_level_scored_with_text.xlsx")
expr_file    <- here("data", "symptom_to_expression.xlsx")
out_file     <- here("OUTPUT", "Medical_profile_symptom_mention_rates.xlsx")

# ============================================================
# 1. Read depression sample with medical profiles
# ============================================================

dat <- read_excel(profile_file) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    history_text = as.character(history_text)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(history_text), str_squish(history_text) != "") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("N participants with depression and medical profiles:", nrow(dat), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 2. Read symptom-expression mapping
# ============================================================

expr_map <- read_excel(expr_file) %>%
  mutate(
    coarser_symptom = str_squish(as.character(coarser_symptom)),
    expression = str_squish(as.character(expression))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(coarser_symptom), coarser_symptom != "",
    !is.na(expression), expression != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(coarser_symptom, expression)

cat("N symptom-expression pairs:", nrow(expr_map), "\n")
cat("N coarser symptoms:", n_distinct(expr_map$coarser_symptom), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 3. Check potentially overlapping expressions
#    Example: "哭" is contained in "容易哭"
# ============================================================

overlap_check <- expr_map %>%
  inner_join(expr_map, by = "coarser_symptom", suffix = c("_short", "_long")) %>%
  filter(
    expression_short != expression_long,
    nchar(expression_short) < nchar(expression_long),
    str_detect(expression_long, fixed(expression_short))
  ) %>%
  arrange(coarser_symptom, expression_short, expression_long)

cat("Potential overlapping expression pairs:", nrow(overlap_check), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 4. Function: longest-first non-overlapping matching
# ============================================================

match_expressions_nonoverlap <- function(text, expressions) {
  if (is.na(text) || length(expressions) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  expressions <- expressions[!is.na(expressions) & expressions != ""]
  expressions <- unique(expressions)

  if (length(expressions) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  # Longest expressions first:
  # e.g., match "容易哭" before "哭"
  expressions <- expressions[order(nchar(expressions), decreasing = TRUE)]

  work_text <- text
  hits <- character(0)

  for (expr in expressions) {
    loc <- gregexpr(expr, work_text, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

    if (loc[1] != -1) {
      hits <- c(hits, expr)

      # Mask matched expression to avoid shorter expressions matching inside it
      mask <- strrep("█", nchar(expr))
      work_text <- gsub(expr, mask, work_text, fixed = TRUE)
    }
  }

  unique(hits)
}

# ============================================================
# 5. Build symptom-level expression list
# ============================================================

symptom_expr_list <- expr_map %>%
  group_by(coarser_symptom) %>%
  summarise(
    expressions = list(unique(expression)),
    expressions_display = paste(unique(expression), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# 6. Participant-level symptom hits
# ============================================================

participant_hits <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(symptom_expr_list)), function(i) {
  symptom_i <- symptom_expr_list$coarser_symptom[i]
  exprs_i   <- symptom_expr_list$expressions[[i]]
  exprs_disp_i <- symptom_expr_list$expressions_display[i]

  dat %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      coarser_symptom = symptom_i,
      expressions_used = exprs_disp_i,
      matched_expressions = map_chr(
        history_text,
        ~ paste(match_expressions_nonoverlap(.x, exprs_i), collapse = "; ")
      ),
      profile_mentioned = matched_expressions != ""
    )
})

# ============================================================
# 7. Symptom-level mention rates
# ============================================================

symptom_mention_rates <- participant_hits %>%
  group_by(coarser_symptom, expressions_used) %>%
  summarise(
    n_depression = n(),
    n_profile_mentioned = sum(profile_mentioned, na.rm = TRUE),
    medical_profile_mention_rate = n_profile_mentioned / n_depression,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(medical_profile_mention_rate), coarser_symptom)

# ============================================================
# 8. Export
# ============================================================

write.xlsx(
  list(
    Symptom_mention_rates = symptom_mention_rates,
    Participant_symptom_hits = participant_hits,
    Expression_mapping_used = expr_map,
    Overlap_expression_check = overlap_check
  ),
  out_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("Done.\n")
cat("Exported:", out_file, "\n")
```
